name: worlds-greatest-stretch
instructions:
1. Stand in an upright position with your feet together and arms at your sides.
2. Step forward into a deep lunge pattern with the back leg extended and place both palms flat on the floor near the inside of your instep. Your elbow will be inside of your knee.
3. Once your hands are in place on the floor, pyramid your hips up towards the ceiling while keeping your finger tips in contact with the floor. You should feel a large stretch in the hamstring of the front leg.
4. Drop the hips back to the deep lunge position and ensure the back leg is straight by flexing the quad.
5. With your hands flat on the floor, exhale, rotate your torso, and reach toward the ceiling with the arm closest to your instep.
6. Follow your hand with your eyes as you rotate.
7. Rotate back to the starting position and stand upright again.
8. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions on each side.
